exposure: Participation in a controlled and supervised exercise program during pregnancy
Intervention group (exercise program) vs. control group (no exercise program)
cohort: 255 pregnant women at the Hospital Senhora da Oliveira between October 2015 and February 2017
finding: The implementation of a controlled and supervised exercise program in pregnancy was associated with significantly lower odds of induced deliveries.
mod_finding: No differences were found between the groups in instrumental vaginal deliveries, cesarean rate.
